descriptions.zh: 我们在[Root.GetName]上发现了一些神秘现象。
descriptions.en: Some strange occurances have been spotted on [Root.GetName].

descriptions.zh: 我们在[Root.GetName]上发现了一些神秘现象。
descriptions.en: Some strange occurances have been spotted on [Root.GetName].

descriptions.zh: 在[Root.GetName]上的迁徙森林会干扰我们殖民地的发展。如果我们想在这颗星球殖民，我们必须想办法解决这个问题。
descriptions.en: The migrating forests on [Root.GetName] are interfering with the development of our colony. A solution to this problem must be found if we are to prosper on this world.

descriptions.zh: 在[Root.GetName]上的一个地底异星文明正朝着我们的殖民地地表挖掘甬道。他们的数量和意图都是未知的，这对于我们殖民地来说可能是一个重大的威胁。
descriptions.en: An underground alien civilization on [Root.GetName] is tunneling towards our colony on the surface. Their numbers and intentions are unknown to us, and they could be a significant threat.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]的一部分在几千年以前曾经被远古文明改造过，但由于未知原因，改造进程搁置了。其结果是这里变成了一个高度不稳定的气候系统和生物圈。我们已经找到了废弃的环境改造设备，必须决定应该做什么。
descriptions.en: [Root.GetName] was partly terraformed by someone thousands of years ago, but the process was interrupted for unknown reasons. The result is a highly unstable climate system and biosphere. We have located the abandoned terraforming equipment, and must decide what should be done with it.

descriptions.zh:
我们在沃陶姆星群内找到了一些史前古器物。沃陶姆是在大约1200万年前活跃的外星文明。虽然这个种族确切的外观已经遗失在时间的迷雾中，但我们从它们的废墟可以推断出，他们是长度约三至四米的类蠕虫环节动物。他们似乎主要通过身体节段的震动来进行沟通。

如果我们能从他们的文明遗迹中找到足够的信息，那么我们也许能精确定位他们母恒星系的位置。
descriptions.en:
We have recovered artifacts from the Vultaum Star Assembly. They were an alien civilization that was active approximately 12 million years ago. Though their exact appearance has been lost in the mists of time, we have deduced from their ruins that they were worm-like annelids, roughly three to four meters in length. They seem to have communicated with each other primarily through vibrations carried along their segmented bodies.

If we can find enough relics from their civilization, it may be possible to pinpoint the location of their home system.

descriptions.zh: 我们已经发现了沃陶姆文明母恒星系的位置。我们必须抢在别人发现这个文明母星系的秘密之前派科研船前去探索！
descriptions.en: We have discovered the long lost location of the Vultaum home system. An expedition must be dispatched there as soon as possible, before someone else uncover their secrets!

descriptions.zh:
我们已经找到了一些来自尤特帝国的史前古器物。他们是一种大约六百万年以前占据一部分星系的外星文明。在生理上，亚特人是一种非常大而扁平的节肢类动物。一个成年亚特的体型可以长到一百米，这使得两个或者三个以上的亚特乘坐同一艘飞船进行星际旅行是一件非常罕见的事情。

如果我们能找到更多他们文明的遗物，那么我们也许能精确定位他们母恒星系的位置。
descriptions.en:
We have recovered artifacts from the Yuht Empire. They were an alien civilization that inhabited a portion of the galaxy roughly six million years ago. Physically the Yuht were very large and flat arthropod analogues. A single individual could reach a length of nearly a hundred meters as an adult, and it was apparently exceedingly rare for more than two or three Yuht to travel aboard the same starship.

If we can find enough relics from their civilization, it may be possible to pinpoint the location of their home system.

descriptions.zh: 我们发现了失落已久的尤特文明母星系的位置。我们必须抢在别人发现这个文明母星系的秘密之前派科研船去探索那里！
descriptions.en: We have discovered the long lost location of the Yuht home system. An expedition must be dispatched there as soon as possible, before someone else uncover their secrets!

descriptions.zh:
我们已经找到了一些来自第一联盟的史前古器物。他们是一个大约两百万年以前和平共生的巨大外星种族邦联。在最终崩溃之前，第一联盟的国境已经囊括了很大的一部分星系。

如果我们能找到更多他们文明的遗物，那么我们也许能精确定位他们母恒星系的位置。
descriptions.en:
We have recovered artifacts from the First League. They were a large confederation of alien races that co-existed in relative peace roughly two million years ago. The First League's borders may have expanded to cover a significant portion of the galaxy before its eventual collapse.

If we can find enough relics from their civilization, it may be possible to pinpoint the location of their home system.

descriptions.zh: 我们发现了失落已久的第一联盟首都恒星系的位置，他们的大参议院就在那里。我们必须抢在别人发现这个文明的秘密之前派科研船去探索那里！
descriptions.en: We have discovered the long lost location of the First League capital system, where their Great Senate was based. An expedition must be dispatched there as soon as possible, before someone else uncover their secrets!

descriptions.zh:
我们已经找到了一些来自伊拉斯协约国的史前古器物。他们是一个大约一百万年以前统治一大片星系的星际政权。六肢哺乳动物伊拉斯人的免疫系统异常地脆弱，使其面对异星传染病时十分容易夭折。据称，伊拉斯人似乎是灭绝于一种称为贾沃疹的席卷全境的瘟疫。

如果我们能找到更多他们文明的遗物，那么我们也许能精确定位他们母星系的位置。
descriptions.en:
We have recovered artifacts from the Irassian Concordat. They were an interstellar power that held sway over a portion of the galaxy a little over a million years ago. The six-limbed mammalian Irassians had unusually weak immune systems that made them especially vulnerable to alien diseases. Some sources claim the Irassians were rendered extinct by the Javorian Pox, a devastating plague that swept across their empire.

If we can find enough relics from their civilization, it may be possible to pinpoint the location of their home system.

descriptions.zh: 我们发现了失落已久的伊拉斯母星系的位置。我们必须抢在别人发现这个文明的秘密之前派科研船去探索那里！
descriptions.en: We have discovered the long lost location of the Irassian home system. An expedition must be dispatched there as soon as possible, before someone else uncover their secrets!

descriptions.zh:
我们在[From.GetName]上找到了赛博勒克斯文明的一些史前古器物。他们是约60万年前控制部分星系的机械集群意识。他们的起源和确切的性质都笼罩在神秘的面纱中，但已知的是这个文明发动了一场针对全体有机智慧生命文明的战争。这场战争持续了好几个世纪，数以万亿计的生命死亡。

如果我们能找到更多他们文明的遗物，那么我们也许能精确定位他们母恒星系的位置。
descriptions.en:
We have recovered artifacts from the Cybrex on [From.GetName]. They were a linked machine consciousness that controlled this portion of the galaxy some 600,000 years ago. Their origins and exact nature are shrouded in mystery, but it is known that they launched a crusade against all sapient organic life that lasted centuries and left trillions dead.

If we can find enough relics from their civilization, it may be possible to pinpoint the location of their home system.

descriptions.zh: 我们发现了失落已久的赛博勒克斯母星系的位置。我们必须抢在别人发现这个文明的秘密之前派科研船去探索那里！
descriptions.en: We have discovered the long lost location of the Cybrex home system. An expedition must be dispatched there as soon as possible, before someone else uncover their secrets!

descriptions.zh: 早在掌握超光速旅行之前，我们从[Root.Capital.GetName]向邻近的恒星系发射了数个亚光速探测器。我们必须在它们落入敌人的手中之前先将他们回收。
descriptions.en: Several sublight exploration probes were dispatched from [Root.Capital.GetName] to neighboring systems before we had mastered FTL travel. They must be recovered before they fall into hostile hands.

descriptions.zh: 我们的外星生物学家敦促我们调查所有发现存在生物圈的星球。他们渴望更深入地了解星系中的各种外星生态系统。
descriptions.en: Our xenobiologists have urged us to survey any worlds with an active biosphere that we come across. They are eager to learn more about the diverse alien ecosystems found throughout the galaxy.

descriptions.zh: [Root.Capital.GetName]的外太空生物博物馆发来请求，他们想请求帮助收集在各颗星球上鉴别出的一些稀有外星生命体。
descriptions.en: The Museum of Exobiology on [Root.Capital.GetName] has asked for help in the collection of several rare alien life forms that have been identified on various different worlds.

descriptions.zh: 自称“[radical_cult.GetName]”的极端组织正试图暗中颠覆我们，蛊惑民众信仰他们扭曲的教义。他们已经在[Root.Capital.GetName]上历兵秣马了数世纪，他们的领袖现已逃往了外太空，以继续进行反对我们的运动。
descriptions.en: Members of an extremist cult calling themselves the "[radical_cult.GetName]" are seeking to undermine our government and subvert the populace to their twisted religion. After spending centuries quietly building up their strength on [Root.Capital.GetName], their leaders have now fled into space to continue their crusade against us.

descriptions.zh: 在动身探索星系之前，我们必须对[home_system.GetName]恒星系进行全面调查。我们必须完全了解自己的“后院”。
descriptions.en: Before venturing into the rest of the galaxy, we should conduct a full survey of the [home_system.GetName] system. Our own backyard must not be left unexplored.

descriptions.zh: 为了确保长期生存，[This.GetSpeciesName]物种需要扩张到[This.Capital.GetName]之外的地方去。建立我们的第一个殖民地，并在外星球的地表上插上[This.GetName]的旗帜。
descriptions.en: The [This.GetSpeciesName] species needs to spread beyond [This.Capital.GetName] to secure its long-term survival. Establish our first colony and plant the banner of the [This.GetName] on the surface of an alien world.

descriptions.zh: 在[Root.GetName]的碰撞轨道上探测到了一颗体积巨大的小行星。必须在它撞击地面之前将它摧毁！
descriptions.en: A large asteroid has been detected on a collision course with [Root.GetName]. It must be destroyed before it impacts the surface!

descriptions.zh: 我们探测到了一个相对我们星系具有接近矢量的神秘亚空间信号群。看来马上有访客要来了……
descriptions.en: A mysterious cluster of subspace contacts has been detected on an approach vector with our galaxy. It would appear that we are about to receive visitors...

descriptions.zh: 一个神秘的快子信号被不明信号源发送向了整个星系。该信号异常微弱，我们无法推测这个信号的作用……也许它是有什么作用的。
descriptions.en: A mysterious tachyon signal is being transmitted throughout the entire galaxy by parties unknown. The signal is extremely faint, and we are unable to deduce its purpose... assuming it has one.

descriptions.zh: 一个休眠于我们所处星系的人工智能文明被唤醒。他们称呼自己为肃正协议，他们致力于肃清所有已知的星系文明——无论是有机文明还是其他的什么。
descriptions.en: A previously dormant AI civilization has been awakened in our galaxy. They refer to themselves as the Contingency, and are dedicated towards the sterilization of all of galactic civilization - organic or otherwise.

descriptions.zh: 我们的星系被一群贪婪的星际生物入侵了，他们意图吞食所有遇到的生命体。必须在这些索林原虫入侵者的数量超过我们之前消灭他们。
descriptions.en: Our galaxy has been invaded by a ravenous swarm of spacefaring creatures that seem intent on consuming all life in their path. The rampage of these Prethoryn invaders must be stopped before their numbers overwhelm us.

descriptions.zh: 我们的星系之中出现了巨大的空间织构裂痕，可作为连接其它次元的单向通道。奇怪的虚体飞船从中涌出，他们会从路上碰到的一切物体身上吸取能源，直到那不幸的物体失去一切能源为止。
descriptions.en: A massive tear in the fabric of space has appeared in our galaxy, acting as some sort of one-way conduit between our reality and another. Strange ethereal spacecraft are pouring in through this dimensional portal, and they seem to leech energy to lethal effect from those unfortunate enough to be caught in their path.

descriptions.zh: 出现了第二阵营的异次元入侵者开始出现在我们星系，攻击意愿不逊于之前一波。幸运的是，两支异次元体部队似乎也打起来了。
descriptions.en: A second faction of extradimensional invaders has appeared in our galaxy, no less hostile than the previous one. Fortunately, the extradimensionals seem to be fighting each other as well.

descriptions.zh: 来自另一个虫洞的三号阵营异次元部队出现了。他们也有意吞噬这个星系中的所有生物，但目前已与前两波入侵者陷入了苦战。
descriptions.en: A third extradimensional faction has emerged from yet another wormhole. Although they are also intent on consuming all life in our galaxy, they seem to be engaged in some kind of three-way war with the other factions from their dimension.

descriptions.zh: 方舟船将我们祖先带到这个[Root.Capital.GetName]星系，而风信子号则是我们的姐妹船。一个世纪以前，从地球出发的风信子号本来是应该跟随我们来到这里的。现在我们必须要搞清楚她到底怎么样了。
descriptions.en: The Hyacinth, a sister ship to the arkship that brought our ancestors to [Root.Capital.GetName], was meant to follow us here from Earth a century ago. We must find out what became of her.

descriptions.zh: 在我们境内侦测到奇怪的外星人出现，我们无法与其建立通讯通道。另外因为我们无法翻译他们的语言，目前只能静观其变。
descriptions.en: We have detected that the odd aliens, whose communication we cannot tap into, have appeared within our borders. Since it's impossible for us to translate their language we can only wait and see who they are and what they want.

descriptions.zh: 强行关闭了远古堡垒的防御系统后，我们派出了一支探索队，进去寻找阻止它重新启动的方法。
descriptions.en: Having forced a shutdown of the ancient fortress, a team of explorers has been sent to find a way of stopping it from powering back up.

descriptions.zh: 我们的研究人员发现了一些七百万年前的数据晶体，晶体内按年代顺序记录了一族被称作§Y古茹努尔§!的太空战士的事迹，以及名为§Y巴奥有机体§!的外星生命，其行星被古茹努尔所入侵。
descriptions.en: Our researchers have uncovered seven million year old datacrystals, chronicling the existence of a space-faring warrior race known as the §YGrunur§!, and the §YBaol Organism§!, an alien lifeform whose planets the Grunur invaded.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]人口上发生的狂暴而野蛮的行为被认为是来之有因的，如果再不约束将会导致整个殖民地化为废墟。
descriptions.en: The wild and ferocious behavior of the population on [Root.GetName] is definitely caused by something, and if unchecked it may destroy the entire colony.

descriptions.zh: 我们的调查表明，一个致力于知识积累的文明残余在§H[curator_poi.GetName]§! 恒星系寻求庇护。
descriptions.en: Our investigations suggest that the remnants of a civilization dedicated to the accumulation of knowledge sought their refuge in the §H[curator_poi.GetName]§! system.

descriptions.zh: 结果证明追踪菌丝体发出的信号是件棘手的活。 我们迷茫的科学家最终定出了“通过蘑菇来一瞥更高纬度”这种假设。关于会带来什么结果的细节完全没有。不过无论如何：这项操作是成功的，并且确实把我们指向了某个目标。
descriptions.en: Tracking the signal emitted by the mycelium proved to be a tricky business. Our puzzled scientist finally managed by 'using mushrooms to peer into additional dimensions.' Details are scarce about what this entails, but in any case: the operation was a success and has pointed us towards a destination.

descriptions.zh: 巨大的尼玛居住在我们的一个星球上，我们已经在他们的背上建立了一个殖民地的基础。我们将决定它们的命运。
descriptions.en: The titanic Nemma inhabit one of our worlds and we have already built the foundation of a colony on their backs. We will need to decide what to do with them.

descriptions.zh: 我们可以在其中一个殖民地上获得潜在的丰富资源，自然形成的通风孔将有价值的资源抛到到太空中。现在，我们需要决定如何处理它们。
descriptions.en: We have access to a potentially lucrative resource on one of our colonies, naturally formed vents expunging valuable resources into space. Now we need to decide on what to do with them.

descriptions.zh: 帕尔乌斯III没有有机生命，但它仍然充满了活动。这些生物是什么，它们能够被合理解释吗？
descriptions.en: Parvus III is devoid of organic life, yet it still swarms with activity. What are these creatures and can they be reasoned with?

descriptions.zh: 我们的任务是找到三颗古泽珞族核心星球。借助§H虚境§!中恩主的指引，我们试着恢复这些地方的技术废墟，用于重新稳定我们的现实与虚境之间的联系。
descriptions.en: We have been tasked with finding three ancient Zroni core worlds. Through the guidance of our benefactor in the §HShroud§!, we will attempt to restore technology lying in ruin at these locations - and restabilize the connection between our reality and the Shroud.
